_selectionCommentary: Julie pre-selected 30 candidates (Website Gallery Pics/Home Page). Trimmed to 20 per the site's own 12-20 target. Ten of the 30 were exact-file duplicates of images already placed on Families or Couples (silhouette-at-sunset, B&W baby feet, garden-flowers girl, both a couples leaves-cheek-to-cheek and a couples forehead-touch shot, siblings-in-leaves, boy-on-steps, the large family group, toddler-in-colorful-setting, and a second couples silhouette) — dropped in favor of images unique to this page. One more (a family in matching white tops) was excluded for the same coordinate-don't-match styling reason it was excluded from Families. Added three Grads and one additional Couples image, since the original 30 were 28 Families to 1 Couples to 0 Grads — this page is meant to represent all four categories. Reordered so the opener is a warm family moment rather than the black-and-white dog photo (kept, just moved mid-gallery), with category variety and B&W/color spaced through rather than clustered.
